basicInfo.requirementsHelp: Block registration until competitors have provided what you need. The register flow points each player at exactly what they are missing.
basicInfo.requireTeamLogoHelp: Teams cannot register until their team logo is uploaded.
basicInfo.requireEsportImagesHelp: Every registering player must have their esport image uploaded on their profile.
basicInfo.requireProfileImageHelp: Every registering player must have a profile image uploaded.
basicInfo.requireUidHelp: Every registering player must have their Free Fire UID set on their profile.
basicInfo.requireWhatsappHelp: Every registering player must have a WhatsApp number saved on their profile. Turn this on when you plan to send room details over WhatsApp.
basicInfo.requireLettersInfoTip: Teams or players must have at least this many Free Fire letter avatars (A-Z) available before they can register. A team's available letters are the combined letters its members own plus any manual extras added on the team editor.
basicInfo.requireLettersHelp: Set the minimum number of letter avatars (1 to 26) competitors must have available to register.
basicInfo.toastImageType: Only PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP files are supported.
basicInfo.registrationInfoTip: Choose whether players pay to register. Paid entry fees are held in escrow by the payment processor and released to the organizer after the event runs.
basicInfo.restrictionsDesc: Control who can register for this event based on their location

prizeRules.cashValueHelp: Required. Your prize distribution below must add up to this amount.
prizeRules.prizeCurrencyHelp: The amounts above are treated as this currency for conversion + display.
prizeRules.toastDocType: Only PDF, DOC, or DOCX files are supported.

registeredTeams.rosterEditOpenTitle: This team can currently edit its roster. Click to close.
registeredTeams.rosterEditClosedTitle: Allow this team to edit its roster (until the event ends).
registeredTeams.emptyRoster: No players on this team's roster.
registeredTeams.repeatNoShowTitle: {recent} no-show(s) in the last 7 days ({total} total)
registeredTeams.toastRosterOpened: Roster editing allowed for this team.
registeredTeams.toastRosterClosed: Roster editing closed for this team.
registeredTeams.toastRosterFailed: Failed to update the team's roster-edit window.
registeredTeams.toastNoLikelyNoShows: No likely no-shows: every registered competitor has results entered.
registeredTeams.detectTeams: {count, plural, one {# registered team has no results entered} other {# registered teams have no results entered}}
registeredTeams.detectPlayers: {count, plural, one {# registered player has no results entered} other {# registered players have no results entered}}
registeredTeams.detectReview: {names}. Review and mark any that didn't show using the No-show button.
registeredTeams.confirmNoShowDescTeam: This frees their slot for a waitlisted team and counts toward their no-show record. Two or more no-shows in a week flags them with a warning other organizers can see. You can undo this later.
registeredTeams.confirmNoShowDescPlayer: This frees their slot for a waitlisted player and counts toward their no-show record. Two or more no-shows in a week flags them with a warning other organizers can see. You can undo this later.
registeredTeams.confirmAssignDesc: Every member of this team will be notified of their assigned letter for this event. A letter can belong to only one team per event, so reassigning frees this team's previous letter. You can change it again anytime.
registeredTeams.confirmClearDesc: This removes the team's assigned letter and frees it for another team. You can assign a new one anytime.

waitlist.cardSubtitle: Allow players to join a waitlist when the event reaches max capacity, so a no-show's slot can be filled by a backup.
waitlist.enableWaitlistHelp: Players can join the waitlist when the event is full and be admitted if spots open up.
waitlist.capacityHelp: Maximum number of players allowed on the waitlist.
waitlist.modeFirstRegisteredHelp: The team/player who joined the waitlist first gets the open slot.
waitlist.modeFcfsRoomHelp: All waitlist teams get the room ID + password; first to join the room claims the slot. You confirm who got in.
waitlist.modeManualAdminHelp: You manually choose which waitlist team/player takes each open slot.
waitlist.discordRoleHelp: Discord role assigned to players on the waitlist.
waitlist.fcfsNotice: Release room details to the group (Event Actions > Broadcast > room details) so the waitlist can see them, then Promote whoever joined the room first.
waitlist.emptyWaitlist: No one on the waitlist yet.

sponsor.cardSubtitle: Attach sponsor entities and build the engagements registrants must complete (collect an ID, follow socials, create an account, join a group).
sponsor.legacyDesc: The old single-sponsor flow (free-text name + one UUID field). Kept so events created before the sponsor system redesign keep working. New events should use the builder above instead.
sponsor.enableRequirementHelp: Players will be prompted to input their sponsor ID during registration.
sponsor.sponsorAccountsHelp: Select one or more sponsor accounts to associate with this event.
sponsor.sponsorsSelected: {count, plural, one {# sponsor selected} other {# sponsors selected}}
sponsor.requirementPlaceholder: e.g. Download the Garena app, create an account, and enter your Garena UUID below.
sponsor.fieldLabelPlaceholder: e.g. Garena UUID, Player ID, Account ID
sponsor.fieldLabelHelp: This label appears next to the input field players see during registration.

coOrganizers.title: Co-organizers
coOrganizers.subtitle: Invite another organization to co-own this event. They must accept; once accepted they can help manage it (per the permissions you grant) and it appears under both organizations.

participantWarning.title: Change Participant Type?
participantWarning.bodyFrom: You are changing the participant type from
participantWarning.warningBody: All currently registered {label} will be automatically removed from this event when you save. This action cannot be undone.

saveConfirm.title: Confirm Save Changes
saveConfirm.noChanges: No changes detected. Are you sure you want to save?
saveConfirm.changesIntro: {count, plural, one {The following change will be saved:} other {The following # changes will be saved:}}

confirmStart.title: Start this tournament?
confirmStart.body: Are you sure you want to start <name></name>?
confirmStart.clearExistingHelp: Remove any existing stage seeds before starting
confirmStart.startAnywayHint: Use "Start anyway" to begin with the competitors registered so far.
confirmStart.toastRegOpenFallback: Registration is still open for this event.

actions.lifecycleDesc: Control the current state of this tournament.
actions.stagePausedDesc: Stage 1 is paused. Resume when you are ready to continue.
actions.stageOngoingDesc: Stage 1 is running. You can pause it anytime.
actions.reopenBeforeStart: This event is {status}. Reopen it before starting.
actions.cancelEventDesc: Mark as cancelled and notify all registered players.
actions.markCompleteDesc: Finalise the event and lock all results.
actions.reopenEventDesc: Set this completed event back to active so you can fix or add results.
actions.endedLocked: This tournament has ended. Results are now locked.
actions.seedingDesc: Distribute competitors into groups and advance stages.
actions.seedToGroupsDesc: Randomly distribute stage competitors into groups.
actions.advanceToNextDesc: Push top competitors from a group into the next stage.
actions.branchingDesc: Split a stage's finishers into different later stages using its routing rules. Preview first to see exactly who advances where.
actions.noRouteYet: No competitors to route yet (no results entered, or no one in range).
actions.seedingMgmtDesc: Undo a seed and reseed, or delete a group or stage and reseed the remaining ones.
actions.undoReseedDesc: Undo clears a stage's group assignments (competitors stay registered). Reseed redistributes them, optionally with a fresh shuffle.
actions.deleteGroupDesc: Remove a group and choose what happens to its competitors.
actions.deleteStageDesc: Remove a stage and choose what happens to its competitors.
actions.communicationDesc: Send notifications and sync roles for registered players.
actions.broadcastAnnouncementDesc: Send an in-app notification to all registered players.
actions.syncDiscordDesc: Re-assign missing Discord group roles for a specific group.
actions.rosterEditingDesc: Open team roster editing for a set period. It closes automatically and can't run past the event end date. While open, team captains can edit their roster even after registration has closed.
actions.notLaterThanEnd: Cannot be later than the event end date{date}.
actions.visibilityDesc: Control event visibility and export participant data.
actions.resultsHiddenNote: . The leaderboard is hidden from players.
actions.exportParticipantsDesc: Download a list of all registered players/teams.
actions.confirmCancelDesc: will be marked as cancelled. Registrations will be frozen and all registered players will be notified.
actions.confirmCompleteDesc: will be finalised. Results will be locked and all registered players will be notified.
actions.confirmReopenDesc: will be set back to active so you can fix or add results. You can mark it complete again afterwards.
actions.confirmHideResultsDesc: The leaderboard for <name></name> will be hidden from players until you publish it again. You can still enter and review results while they are hidden.
actions.confirmPublishResultsDesc: The leaderboard for <name></name> will be visible to everyone on the tournament page.
actions.broadcastDialogDesc: Send an in-app notification to all registered players in <name></name>.
actions.emailBrandedNote: Emails are sent in the standard AFC branded design.
actions.broadcastHistoryDesc: Every announcement, stage/group message and room-details push sent for <name></name>.
actions.deleteGroupDialogDesc: Choose what happens to the competitors in this group.
actions.deleteStageDialogDesc: Choose what happens to the competitors in this stage.
actions.dispGroupAutoDesc: Move its competitors into the stage's remaining groups.
actions.dispGroupManualDesc: Keep them registered but unassigned. You place them yourself.
actions.dispGroupDeleteAllDesc: Remove the group and its competitors from the stage.
actions.dispStageAutoDesc: Move competitors to another stage and distribute into its groups.
actions.dispStageManualDesc: Move competitors to another stage; you place them later.
actions.dispStageDeleteAllDesc: Remove the stage and everything in it.
actions.toastPickRosterClose: Pick the date & time the roster-edit window should close.
actions.toastRosterOpened: Roster editing is now open for teams.
actions.toastRosterWindowFailed: Failed to update the roster-edit window
actions.toastSelectStageGroup: Select a stage and group first
actions.toastSelectTargetStage: Select a target stage to move competitors into
actions.toastPickStageBroadcast: Pick a stage to broadcast to
actions.toastPickGroupBroadcast: Pick a group to broadcast to

autoSeed.title: Fully-automatic event
autoSeed.desc: When on, once this event's start time passes it automatically seeds the available teams (registered, not waitlisted; and checked-in when check-in is on) into the entry stage's groups. You then just enter each group's room ID and password.
autoSeed.toggleLabel: Auto-seed teams into groups at start
autoSeed.seedNowHelp: Runs the same seed immediately (only if the entry stage isn't already seeded).

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.desc: When on, every registered competitor must log in and tap Check-in inside the window. A squad is eligible only when all its players check in; anyone who does not is moved to the waitlist.
checkin.windowHelp: Check-in opens after registration ends and closes before the event starts.

groupMover.help: Drag a team from one group into another (on a phone, press and hold a team briefly, then drag, or just tap the move button to pick its new group). Use the remove button to take a team out of a group or the whole stage. Teams that already have results can't be moved or removed until you clear those results.
groupMover.dragToMove: Drag to another group to move this team
groupMover.moveToAnotherGroup: Move this team to another group
groupMover.forceBody: This team already has results entered in its current group. Moving it leaves those results in the old group's standings. Move anyway?
groupMover.removeBodyPool: Remove this team from the stage. It stays registered for the event.
groupMover.removeBodyGroup: Remove this team from just this group (it stays seeded in the stage), or from the whole stage. Either way it stays registered for the event.
groupMover.moveChooseGroup: Choose the group to move this team into.
